summary: Evolve the Release issue template for the standing Next Release lifecycle, packaging rename, heavy-release validation, and immediate spawn of the next planning target.
migration_impact: Release issues should now begin life as the single standing `Next Release` planning target, with the version field remaining optional until packaging locks `vX.Y.Z`.
migration_guidance: 1. Update `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/release.yml` so new release issues start as `Next Release` instead of assuming a version is already known.
2. During packaging, rename or replace the standing issue with the concrete versioned release issue and keep the checklist aligned with the packaging/finalization flow.
3. After packaging begins, immediately create a fresh standing `Next Release` issue so future work has a canonical target.
agent_notes: Do not create separate standing Major/Minor/Patch release issues. Use one `Next Release` issue plus Major/Minor/Patch labels on work items and the corresponding release-track branches.
